hooks.name: Wire a new object and prove it
hooks.description: When an object file is created in apps/<game>/src/objects/, put it in the game's registry, its tests and its docs, then run the proof. A failing object gets a plain-English reason and the game refuses its levels until it is fixed.

hooks.name: Prove a changed object
hooks.description: When an object file is saved, wire it again and run the proof, so a change of width or sound is checked at once.
